- Initial release of Fleece: a CLI tool for live US credit card research using Brave Search.
- Provides full credit card reports, earning rates, transfer partners, statement credits, recent news, card comparisons, wallet/portfolio analysis, ROI calculations, and personalized recommendations.
- All command outputs are in JSON for easy programmatic use.
- Supports stdin piping for card names and profiles.
- Covers major US issuers including Amex, Chase, Citi, Capital One, and more.
